user.t:
Translate Markdown documents into Norwegian Bokmal and save each as a new file next to its English source. Do not touch any other file, do not run git, do not run tests.

Sources (in C:\Users\mariu\ventures\ap-recovery), each -> same name with .no.md:
1. business/business-plan.md
2. business/market-analysis.md
3. business/README.md
4. fundraising/README.md
5. hiring/README.md

Rules:
- Faithful translation: keep the exact structure, headings order, tables, bullet lists, and every number, date, percentage, identifier, file path, env var, code, URL and product/company name unchanged (PRGX, Apex Analytix, Basware, Coupa etc.). Do NOT translate content inside code blocks or inline code.
- Keep all caveats, status banners and disclaimers (pre-product, ASSUMPTION labels, grade A/B/C, crowded category, weak moat, DEFER verdict, not investment advice) with the same strength. Do not add, remove or soften claims. Do not invent any new facts or figures. Keep the label "ASSUMPTION" as "ANTAGELSE (ASSUMPTION)" the first time in each file and "ANTAGELSE" afterwards.
- Relative links to other .md files keep pointing to the English files (leave link targets unchanged); translate only link text.
- Natural, precise Norwegian suited to finance/business readers. No emojis. UTF-8 Norwegian letters are fine.
- Use the Write tool to create the files (read each source fully first with the Read tool). Reply with only a one-line confirmation listing the files written.
